historical-dialogue.npc: Death is everywhere! At any moment, a band of brigands might rush in and kill you, or your closest friend might stab you in the back. Welcome to Gelin's Life Insurance Brokerage.

steps.npc: When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.

Tell me about yourself.

steps.npc: I am Gelin, the greatest assassin ever to train in Al Kharid. If you have not heard of me, that is because my victims never live to speak of me.
In my years as a warrior of fortune, I have fought in many lands, meeting fighters of all calibres, and I found they all had something in common:
Every single one had a soul-gripping fear that they would suffer a humiliating defeat at the hands of their foes.
They did not fear the pain, you understand. They feared the diminishment that comes with defeat.
To see one's wealth in the hands of another. To see one's skills decrease, as the hard-earned experience is lost. That is what they all feared.
Thus I was inspired to create this life insurance brokerage. I can protect your Hitpoints experience, so that you will not lose so much of it when you are defeated.
I cannot protect other skills, and I have no intention whatsoever of protecting anyone's items - a victor deserves their spoils.

options.text: Why do you sell life insurance in a graveyard?

steps.player: Why do you sell life insurance in a graveyard?

steps.npc: There is no more fitting place! The graves of the dead remind the living that their lives are fragile, and that death is the inescapable fate of all mortals.
That is exactly the frame of mind that encourages people to buy life insurance from me.

options.text: Can I ever get a refund on this insurance?

steps.player: Can I ever get a refund on this insurance?

steps.npc: No, my life insurance policies are for life. Similarly, when a customer upgrades their policy to a better one, I charge the full price of the new policy. They may take it or leave it.

options.text: Goodbye.
